evidence: The track crosses the peninsula’s clifftop, with excellent views of the Seaward Kaikōura Range, ocean and coastline, to South Bay. It returns to the township via South Bay and Toms Track.
From the town centre, follow the footpath and road verge along The Esplanade, Avoca Street and Fyffe Quay to Point Kean.
From the South Bay shelter, return to Kaikōura town centre by following the marker posts along the coast towards the marina.
Follow the marker posts to South Bay Parade and cross to South Bay Track, walk up the hill, cross Scarborough Street and walk down Toms Track to return to The Esplanade.

doubts: Start and end: the walkway starts and returns to Kaikōura township, so I used the place Kaikōura (T3). Point Kean car park is F1 (where Clifftop Walk meets Fyffe Quay), the best match for the car park at the end of the Fyffe Quay road section, but the text does not name it that way. F2, F3 and F4 are not matched to any named place in the text (South Bay carpark, South Bay Parade and Scarborough Street are given without refs). The order of Fyffe House and Armers Beach is taken from the text's 'near Fyffe House' and 'nearby Armers Beach' on the way to Point Kean, so their exact order is uncertain. Fyffe House is on the way per the text but has no packet entry. The whole walkway's time is the text's 'allow at least three hours to complete the whole walkway', copied as the time; the distance is not stated for the whole way (section distances sum to about 11.7 km, not written). The two short walks in 'Other options/short walks' have their own headings and times, so they are recorded as separate one-way ways. Whalers Bay is a side trip from the Whalers Bay viewpoint and its shoreline return is not a DOC maintained track. Direction is not stated.
